from collections import Counter
def transform3(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    mid=next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and cnt[grid[0][j]]==h)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    left=[r[:mid] for r in grid]; right=[r[mid+1:] for r in grid]
    return [[3 if left[i][j]==right[i][j] else bg for j in range(mid)] for i in range(h)]
